    Irreducible differentials of finite string boundary squares #

    This file connects the explicit boundary-square maps to the maximal hook and cohook maps whose irreducibility has already been proved.

    Adding a left hook does not destroy maximality of the already maximal right hook at the opposite endpoint.

              The positive two-hook complex is short exact without a middle-summand case hypothesis. Detector classification turns an isomorphism of the middle modules into literal word equality, while nonisomorphic summands use the ordinary binary-biproduct criterion.
